CheckIn.iciIntro: Please read the passenger and baggage rules below carefully before checking in.
CheckIn.iciRule1: The name on the boarding pass must match the ID you travel with (national ID, passport, VNeID; children under 14: birth certificate).
CheckIn.iciRule2: Online check-in is not available for pregnant passengers, passengers travelling with infants under 2, or passengers needing special assistance (wheelchair, medical) — please check in at the airport counter.
CheckIn.iciRule3: Dangerous goods (explosives, flammables, compressed gases, toxic or corrosive substances…) are strictly prohibited in both carry-on and checked baggage.
CheckIn.iciRule4: Power banks and spare lithium batteries must be in carry-on baggage only, never checked in.
CheckIn.iciRule5: Liquids, knives, scissors and sharp objects in carry-on baggage must comply with airport security rules.
CheckIn.iciRule6: Checked baggage: go to the Baggage Drop counter before it closes. Be at the gate before boarding time — the airline may refuse carriage if you are late.
CheckIn.iciRule7: Once checked in, the booking can no longer be cancelled online.
CheckIn.iciAgree: I have read, understood and accept these rules for all selected passengers.

CancellationPolicy.title: Cancellation policy
CancellationPolicy.intro: You can cancel your booking yourself under "My bookings". The refund is calculated automatically at the moment you cancel, based on the time left before departure.
CancellationPolicy.tierFixedResult: {fee} fee per passenger, the rest is refunded
CancellationPolicy.example: Example: a booking for {pax} passengers totalling {total}, cancelled 10 hours before departure → {fee} fee, {refund} refunded.
CancellationPolicy.timeBasis: Times are measured in Vietnam time (GMT+7) at the exact moment you cancel.
CancellationPolicy.paidAmountBasis: Refunds are based on the amount you actually paid (after any promo code). The fee never exceeds the amount paid.
CancellationPolicy.roundTripCase1: Neither flight flown yet: the table above applies based on the outbound departure time, to the whole booking.
CancellationPolicy.roundTripCase2: Outbound already flown: only the return flight is cancelled and refunded, based on the return departure time. The flown leg is not charged a fee.
CancellationPolicy.roundTripCase3: Both flights flown: the trip is complete and can no longer be cancelled.
CancellationPolicy.roundTripWhole: You cannot choose to cancel a single leg — each cancellation applies to the whole booking.
CancellationPolicy.unpaid: Unpaid bookings: cancel for free at any time and the seats are released immediately. Bookings not paid within about {hold} minutes are cancelled automatically.
CancellationPolicy.checkedIn: After online check-in (opens {hours} hours before departure): the booking can no longer be cancelled online.
CancellationPolicy.airlineCancel: Flight cancelled by the airline: 100% refund with no fee (for round trips, a leg you have already flown is not refunded).
CancellationPolicy.promoCode: Promo code uses are not returned when a booking is cancelled.
CancellationPolicy.refundProcess: The refund amount is recorded immediately and shown in "My bookings"; the transfer back to you is handled by customer support.
CancellationPolicy.noChange: Changing a booking (date, time or flight) is not supported yet: if needed, cancel under this policy and make a new booking.
